thread:
devon: Following up from the postmortem (INC-4321) — we agreed to add a few concrete tests and owners. I'll sketch proposals here, please ack and update ownership.

maria: Ack. Can we separate into (1) regression prompt set, (2) KV eviction load test, (3) chaos drill? I can take #1 if no objections. :raised_hands:

kevin: I can own the KV eviction load test. Proposal: a k6-style load job that ramps to 900-1k RPS for 30m with periodic GC/eviction noise. We'll instrument tail-latency and evictions.

priya: For the chaos drill, I'd like to run a scoped game-day in staging next month. Suggest window: 2025-02-20 09:00-12:00 UTC. Anyone blocked?

alex: I'll volunteer for the prompt set if maria wants infra help. We should capture both regeneration and hallucination regression checks (exact-match + semantic sim).

maria: Great — alex, please pair on the eval definitions. I'll author the first promptset and baseline expectations. Plan: add to CI with a nightly run and on deploy to dedicated.

kevin: Example k6 script snippet for the KV eviction scenario (will refine):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export default function () {
  http.post('https://staging-inference.redwood/api/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'lorem ipsum'}), { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(0.01);
}
```
Tune uniques/seq-len later. We'll also toggle small-LLM fallback to test routing.

priya: For the chaos drill I'll add failure injections: network delay to cache tier, instance drain on a subset of pods, and force-fallback to model-variant. Need owners for runbook steps.

devon: Owners summary so far: maria = promptset (TKT-7891), kevin = KV load test (TKT-7892), priya = chaos drill coordination (TKT-7893), alex = promptset pairing (TKT-7894). Please confirm and set target dates.

sre-oncall: Quick note — please ensure runbooks include an auto-escalation to oncall if latency > 500ms for >5m during tests. I'll add a checklist item.

alex: Confirmed. For promptset delivery target: 2025-01-31. I'll scope 200 prompts across common failure modes.

maria: Confirmed. CI job name: `regression/promptset/incident-4321`. I'll open PR to add baseline eval and a gating threshold.

kevin: KV load test target: 2025-02-07. Will push a k6 job + grafana dashboard + eviction alert rule.

priya: Chaos drill tentative date OK for me (2025-02-20). I'll schedule a 2-week prep with runbooks and a dry-run.

devon: I'll centralize action-items in the postmortem doc and set reminders. Quick owners + due dates: maria/2025-01-31, kevin/2025-02-07, priya/2025-02-20. If anyone needs to move a date, call it out here.

maria: I'll open the promptset PR today and ping infra for test data. TKT-7891 created.

kevin: TKT-7892 created, linking to grafana board `eviction-kv/incident-4321`.

evals-bot: Automated note: New evals created: `incident-4321-promptset` (CI: nightly), `incident-4321-kv-load` (staging only). See https://evals.redwood/internal/4321

devon: Thanks all. Action: we'll reconvene in two weeks for status. If no objections, I'll mark items as owners-assigned in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
